ctx.x: Hotel had the beautiful Blue Room. She had 11 hotels. Thelma Carpenter was our vocalist. We didn't have nobody but Jimmie Rushing; and the only women vocalists that sang in that band at that time was from Billie to Helen Humes to Thelma, and then Thelma was out. We didn't have no other woman.
When did you leave? That's as long as you were there.
